title: A related note on another subject does not reorder
what: The false-positive guard of the restated-note rule (A33). Alice records the build server, then later the API server of the same project: related words, same writer, both match the question, but a different subject. The later note is not a restatement, so the order stays as the search ranks it and nothing is labelled as restated.

steps.title: {{proj}} API server
steps.body: The {{proj}} API server is {{v3}}; it also serves the status page.

expect.desc: search keeps the build server note where it ranks
the 'what is relevant' lookup keeps it where it ranks
no note is labelled as restated in search
no note is labelled as restated in the lookup
